import socket, json, os, time
# Test QMP
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect("/tmp/qmp.sock")
s.settimeout(5)
data=s.recv(4096)
print("QMP greeting:", data[:200])
s.sendall(json.dumps({"execute":"qmp_capabilities"}).encode()+b"\n")
print("QMP caps resp:", s.recv(4096)[:500])
# QMP send-key test (a key)
s.sendall(json.dumps({"execute":"send-key", "arguments":{"keys":[{"type":"qcode","data":"ret"}]}}).encode()+b"\n")
print("QMP send-key resp:", s.recv(4096)[:500])
# QMP query-status
s.sendall(json.dumps({"execute":"query-status"}).encode()+b"\n")
print("QMP status:", s.recv(4096)[:500])
s.close()
print("QMP OK")
# Test monitor
m=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
m.connect("/tmp/monitor.sock")
m.settimeout(5)
# monitor sends greeting?
try:
    print("MON greeting:", m.recv(4096)[:500])
except Exception as e:
    print("MON no greeting:", e)
m.sendall(b"help\n")
time.sleep(0.5)
print("MON help:", m.recv(8192)[:800])
m.sendall(b"info status\n")
time.sleep(0.5)
print("MON status:", m.recv(4096)[:800])
m.sendall(b"sendkey ret\n")
time.sleep(0.5)
print("MON sendkey resp:", m.recv(4096)[:800])
m.close()
print("MONITOR OK")
P
